title: Build a full working admin dashboard panel (routes, access control, and CRUD)

requirements.text: Make the Admin Dashboard discoverable and accessible: ensure there is a visible navigation entry to the admin dashboard for administrators and that the admin dashboard is reachable at the /admin route (with sub-routes /admin/categories, /admin/breeds, /admin/videos).

quotes: please build a full working admin dashboard panel

acceptanceCriteria: When a signed-in admin visits the app, the top navigation displays an “Admin” link.
Clicking “Admin” navigates to /admin and renders the Admin Dashboard landing page without errors.
Non-admin users do not see the “Admin” navigation link.
Directly visiting /admin (and sub-routes) as a non-admin shows an “Access Denied” screen (not a blank page).

requirements.text: Implement a reliable admin authorization flow so at least one administrator can successfully pass the frontend admin check (actor.isCallerAdmin) after deployment and can use the admin dashboard end-to-end.

quotes: please build a full working admin dashboard panel

acceptanceCriteria: The backend exposes a working isCallerAdmin method used by the frontend role check.
There is a secure, documented bootstrap mechanism so at least one principal can be an admin in a fresh deployment (without requiring code edits post-deploy).
Calls to admin-only backend methods (category/breed/video CRUD) succeed for admin callers and trap with an authorization error for non-admin callers.

requirements.text: Deliver a complete Admin Dashboard experience with working CRUD for pet categories, breeds, and admin-managed video links, including image upload support, using the existing admin pages and hooks.

quotes: please build a full working admin dashboard panel

acceptanceCriteria: Admins can create, edit, and delete Pet Categories from /admin/categories and the list refreshes after each mutation.
Admins can create, edit, and delete Breeds from /admin/breeds (including selecting a category) and the list refreshes after each mutation.
Admins can create, edit, and delete Video Links from /admin/videos for: Breed videos, Category videos, and Health-topic videos, and changes are reflected immediately in the admin lists.
Image uploaders in admin forms successfully store and render uploaded images (preview and saved state) using the existing blob storage integration.
All admin pages provide clear success/error feedback (e.g., toast messages) for create/update/delete actions.

requirements.text: Apply a cohesive, distinct visual theme for the admin dashboard pages (layout, typography, spacing, and component styling) that is consistent across /admin, /admin/categories, /admin/breeds, and /admin/videos.

quotes: please build a full working admin dashboard panel

acceptanceCriteria: Admin pages share a consistent visual style (headers, cards, forms, tables/lists, and spacing).
The theme avoids a default-looking appearance and does not rely on blue/purple as the primary palette.
The admin section looks clearly separated from the user-facing pages while remaining part of the same product design system.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; create backend/migration.mo only if a state upgrade is required.

Do not edit frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or anything under frontend/src/components/ui; compose existing UI components instead.
Use Internet Identity for authentication; no third-party auth providers.
nonGoals: Implementing non-Internet-Identity authentication (email/password, OAuth, Auth0, etc.).
Adding real-time collaboration, WebSockets, chat, push notifications, or email/SMS workflows.
Introducing external databases or additional backend services beyond the single canister actor.
